We here provide further elements for reply LS to SA5 following their LS to RAN3 in [1]. The LS from SA5 was sent in the context of their ongoing study on TraceMDT phase 2, but no problem statement was so far captured in the study on this topic. We therefore believe that the LS serves the purpose of initial exploration of current RAN mechanisms enabling correlation of trace data in the TCE in scenarios involving DC and split architecture, identifying potential issues that would need to be addressed in Rel-18. It therefore also seems that SA5 when sending the LS didn’t take into account RAN3’s Rel-16 enhancements of the Cell Traffic Trace mechanism into account, or forwarding of MDT configuration on the Xn interface for MR-DC introduced in Rel-17.
